subject: general
question: What was the unemployment rate among youth aged 15-29 in rural areas in May 2025, as per the PLFS?
solution:
The correct answer is __**13.7%**__.
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS)** is a critical survey conducted by the **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)** to estimate key employment and unemployment indicators.
 
• As per the data released for **May 2025**, the **unemployment rate** for the **youth** population, specifically those in the **age group of 15-29 years**, was a focal point of the report.
 
• In **rural areas**, the **unemployment rate** for this specific youth demographic was recorded at **13.7%**. ***Hence, the correct answer is 13.7%.***
 
• The **Unemployment Rate (UR)** is defined as the percentage of persons unemployed among the persons in the **labour force** (which includes both employed persons and those seeking work).
 
• The **PLFS** serves as a primary source of **data** for the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** to monitor the health of the **Indian economy** and the effectiveness of employment schemes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Periodic Labour Force Survey (PLFS):**
 
 
• Launched in **April 2017**, the **PLFS** was established to provide more frequent and reliable **labour force data**.
 
• It has two main objectives: to estimate employment indicators in **Current Weekly Status (CWS)** every three months for **urban areas** and to estimate indicators in both **Usual Status** and **CWS** annually for both **rural** and **urban areas**.
 
 
 
• **Key Definitions:**
 
 
• **Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR):** The percentage of the population that is either working or seeking work.
 
• **Worker Population Ratio (WPR):** The percentage of employed persons in the total population.
 
• **Unemployment Rate (UR):** The percentage of those in the **labour force** who are currently without work but available for and seeking it.
 
 
 
• **Youth Demographics:**
 
 
• In the context of Indian **government surveys** and the **National Youth Policy**, **youth** is generally defined as persons in the **age group of 15-29 years**.
 
• Monitoring this specific group is essential for addressing **skill development** needs and reducing **demographic** pressures on the **job market**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Measurement Status:**
 
 
• **Usual Status (ps+ss):** This determines the employment status of a person based on a reference period of **365 days** preceding the date of the survey.
 
• **Current Weekly Status (CWS):** This determines the status based on a reference period of **7 days** preceding the survey date. A person is considered employed if they worked for at least **one hour** on any day during the reference week.
 
 
 
• **Organizational Framework:**
 
 
• The **National Sample Survey Office (NSSO)** operates under the **Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation (MoSPI)** of the **Government of India**.
 
• Data collected through these surveys influences major policy decisions related to **MGNREGA**, **Skill India**, and other **social security** initiatives.
